verdict.rationale: The only relevant evidence is a 2016 community comment saying Angular Universal provides server-side prerendering, which made pages faster and indexable. That covers basic server rendering. Nothing in the pack mentions streaming responses or faster time-to-interactive, and no first-party docs on SSR appear. Missing for 10: first-party SSR documentation, streaming SSR support, hydration or interactivity-timing evidence, current hands-on corroboration.
